mapper.select: SELECT db_article.article_id articleId, db_article.article_title articleTitle, db_article.article_tag articleTag, db_article.o_id_user oIdUser, db_article.publish_date publishDate, db_article.article_img1 articleImgUrl, db_article.article_content articleContent, ifnull((SELECT sum(op_article_like_collect.o_id_user) FROM op_article_like_collect WHERE db_article.article_id = op_article_like_collect.article_id AND like_state = '1'), 0) skrNum, ifnull((SELECT sum(op_article_like_collect.o_id_user) FROM op_article_like_collect WHERE db_article.article_id = op_article_like_collect.article_id AND collect_state = '1'), 0) collectionNum, ifnull((SELECT like_state FROM op_article_like_collect WHERE db_article.article_id = op_article_like_collect.article_id AND op_article_like_collect.o_id_user = #{userId}), '0') isSkr, ifnull((SELECT collect_state FROM op_article_like_collect WHERE db_article.article_id = op_article_like_collect.article_id AND op_article_like_collect.o_id_user = #{userId}), '0') isCollection FROM db_article ORDER BY (SELECT sum(op_article_like_collect.o_id_user) FROM op_article_like_collect WHERE db_article.article_id = op_article_like_collect.article_id AND like_state = '1') DESC LIMIT 8
